en.name: Fiddler
en.ability: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players choose which of these 2 players win.
en.flavor: I'll wager mi lyef ye cannae best me in a fiddle contest, ye boss-eyed snook! We'll go out on the lash, get the pub jammers an' have a right craic. I'll be layin' ma boots into ya come mornin' ye rumbly muppet.

zh.name: 小提琴手
zh.ability: 每局游戏一次，恶魔秘密选择一名对立阵营玩家：所有玩家选择这2人中谁获胜。
